allowed_access.method: HTTP Range requests one byte at a time, beginning at byte 0
allowed_access.stop_condition: first LF byte; if CRLF, the CR immediately preceding LF is part of the physical header terminator

parser_freeze_rule_after_gate1: Column semantics may be mapped only from the exact physical header plus USGS public metadata/documentation. No data row may be opened before the parser, annual-state construction, estimability gate, model arms, split, metrics and terminal decision are committed.
no_rescue: A server that does not honor exact byte ranges, a header longer than 2048 bytes, invalid UTF-8, malformed CSV header, or ambiguous required column semantics terminates this v1 before response values.
